title: Leaf-to-root paths
brief: Trace each leaf back to its root.
instructions: For every leaf, return numeric category identities joined by > from leaf to root, including both endpoints. Include a root that is itself a leaf.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes category_id,parent_category_id,c_name from categories without solving leaf-to-root paths.

hints.text: Start recursion at leaves and follow parent identities.
Carry the original leaf identity and append each ancestor until its parent is NULL.
A path starts with the leaf, not the root; duplicate names are not path keys.
